rationale: Fix-up diff (e3caac493..c6848ed42) addresses all 6 blocking findings from code-review-final.json with clear, verifiable evidence: handleAddProject no longer chains a second independent handleSetDefault call (removing both the swallowed-failure and double-onProjectsChange defects, CR-002), the add-with-default optimistic updater now sets is_default correctly for the new row in the same pendingOp as the add itself (no more stale-list flicker, CR-003), a settingDefaultFor guard disables every toggle while any set-default call is pending (CR-004), the toggle button now has an aria-label (CR-005), the users-list marker check now targets a stable data-testid instead of a generic svg query (CR-001), and the spec-required no-op test was added (CR-006). Re-ran the full affected unit + integration suites after the fix-up: 38/38 unit tests pass (including the new no-op test) and the 1 integration test passes. No new high-risk issue suspected in the fix-up diff (state/prop/aria/test-assertion changes only, no new API surface), so no confirmation pass was dispatched.

finding_status.notes: Integration test now asserts on data-testid="default-project-marker" instead of a generic svg query; re-ran, passes.

handleAddProject no longer chains a separate handleSetDefault call; add+set-default is one setProjects call with one try/catch and a single onProjectsChange invocation, so a set-default failure now propagates to the outer catch instead of being swallowed.

The add's optimistic updater now constructs the new project with is_default: setAsDefault and un-defaults the rest in the same pendingOp, so the marker is correct immediately with no dependency on a second pendingOp seeing a not-yet-committed row.
settingDefaultFor state added; every toggle's disabled now includes `settingDefaultFor !== null`, blocking overlapping clicks while a set-default call is in flight.
aria-label={item.is_default ? 'Default project' : 'Set as default project'} added to the toggle button.
New test 'clicking the already-default row is a no-op' added to UserProjectsTable.test.tsx and passing.
